tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rang gzhan smin byed kyi phyag len shin tu gsal ba yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed bzhugs so// na maḥ.ā nan+da pu ṇ+yā ya/ na mo badz+ra kī la ya/ rab dkar dge legs bye ba'i sa 'dzin ngos/ /rab brjid rin chen khri steng bsil zer dbus/ /rab mchog kun dga'i mtshan can yid 'ong sku/ /rab mdzes dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs dang / /phur srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /kun nas dwang ba'i yid kyis rnam par 'dud/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs kyi gtso/ /nye lam rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gzhi/ /rang gzhan smin byed dbang gi cho ga dag /'khrul med sa lo'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya/ /'dir dpal rdo rje phur pa'i lam thams cad chu bo bzhir 'dus pa las de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhir gyur pa ni/ smin byed dbang gi cho ga skur byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa yin pas de la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /de'ang sdom ni/ sngon 'gro gang zag gnas dang ni/ /sa chog sta gon rnam pa bzhi/ /dngos gzhi la yang dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ /dbang bskur ba dang rnam pa gnyis/ /rjes chog rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes pa las/ spyi don dang po sngon 'gro la bzhi las/ gang zag dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rdo rje las rim dang dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba gnyis su blta'o/ /gsum pa sa chog la bdun te/ dkyil chog las/ sa chog la yang rnam pa bdun/ /sa gzhi bslang brtag sbyang ba dang / /byin brlab sta gon bzung bsrung bya/ /brtag la'ang lto 'phye chu yi bkra/ /sbyang la'ang phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /bzung la blo dang stangs stabs kyis/ /bzung ba rnam gnyis gnyis pa la/ /gsol ba gdab dang bgegs bskrad pa'o/ /bskrad la byin brlab bka' bsgo dang / /stangs stabs rnam gsum bsrung ba la/

/phur gdab srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /zhes pa las/ sa bslang ba la gnang ba las bslang ba dang / sa brtag pa gnyis dgos na rtogs par sla ba bzhin no/ /gzhan rnams ni sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i rtogs par sla ba'i zur 'debs rin po che'i do shal bzhin las zhal 'phangs dang mi gsal ba cung zad yod pa rnams brjod na/ mi gnang ba las bslang ba'i skabs su/ hūm̐ḥs phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar/ /khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyis/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du song / /zhes dang / sa sbyang ba la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa yan sa lo nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin mdzad nas/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor bsngo bshags pa yan tshar ba dang / sbyang ba dngos ni/ rang gi mig g.yas pa zhes pa nas bi shud+dhe bha wan+tu zhes pa'i bar zur 'debs bzhin/ sa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ pa pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma'i gdan du gyur nas/ biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ gis mchod pa'i bar dang rol chen mdzad/ gtor ma byin brlab ni/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twad oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir dpang gyur lha mos kyang / /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs kyi skabs slob ma yod na 'jug cing dbang blangs pa'i mthar/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa bgyid na sogs 'jug go

/gzhan gser gyi sa gzhir gyur zhes pa'i bar zur 'debs bzhin/ sa sta gon gyi sngar dung chos sogs su bshams pa'i dri bzang dang chang bsres pa 'thor/ yab kyis tshigs bcad re'i mjug gi sngags dang bstun dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sa la gtor te/ hūm̐ḥchos dbyings dag pa'i bdud rtsi mi bskyod pa/ /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā mu traṃ maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ de bzhin 'don pa bsgyur zhing rigs 'gre sbyar la/ me long dag pa'i bdud rtsi rnam snang 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang smad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā bi dra maṇ+ḍa la oṃ/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i bdud rtsi rak+ta 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang smad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā ru dhi ra maṇ+ḍa la swā/ kun rtog dag pa'i bdud rtsi byang sems 'dis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang smad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā shukla maṇ+ḍa la ā/ bya grub dag pa'i bdud rtsi sha chen 'dis/ rgyal ba'i phrin las dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bka' gsang smad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā maṃ sa maṇ+ḍa la hā/ zhal nas hūm̐ hūm̐ rab brjod pas/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og rdo rje dang / /gur las me 'od 'bar bar gyur/ /rak+ṣa'i sngags tshar gcig sngags 'di la dri bzang mi 'thor/ sa blos bzung ba la/ bdag gis sems can don bya'i phyir/

/lha mo khyod kyis dpang gyis shig /rin chen sna tshogs phye btags pas/ /bdag gi don yod dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes brjod cing sems can gyi don du dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lam nyams su len pa'i bsod nams 'dis/ bdag 'tshang rgya ba'i dus su bdud dpa' skong ba'i tshe lha mo khyod kyis dpang mdzod cig snyam du bsam mo/ /stangs stabs kyis bzung ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i skabs su/ shar grub nas/ lho sogs kyi skabs su mchod pa rnams chu dang me tog kha gso/ lha bshos dang mar me gsar pa spos/ byin rlabs kyang rim pa bzhin mdzad/ slob dpon yang shar grub pa dang lho sogs la zhal bsgyur zhing / mchod pa byin rlabs kyi rol mo dang bstun phyag dril gsil tsam gnang / de nas mchod pa tshar rim gyis/ rnam rgyal gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i gtso bos shar nas/ de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ mchog tu gsang ba yum gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /dus gsum 'du 'bral med pa rtag tu sbyor/ /gnyis med thig le byang chub dag pa'i sku/ /byang chub rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi sku/ /phyag rgya rdzogs pa kun gyi gnas/ /mtha' gnyis las ni rnam rgyal ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ lho nas thams cad dbang sdud ma'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ rol pa'i cho 'phrul che la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /bka' yi 'khor lo gsang ba'i yon tan ston/ /thugs rjes cho 'phrul chos kyi char yang 'bebs/ /gsang sngags bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / 'chi bdag bdud ni tshar gcod cing / /mi mthun log lta 'joms mdzad pa/ /yon tan rin chen kun gyi gnas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ nub nas 'dod chags khros pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/

e ma hoḥ gsung gi thigs pa thugs kyi rgya mtsho'i klong / /lung dang man ngag gtan tshigs chos kyi mdzod/ /dus gsum rnal 'byor dbang phyug bgrod pa'i shul/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i mdzod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam par sbyong / /rdo rje'i gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ byang nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ e ma hoḥ dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs kyi thugs/ /mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin byed pa/ /smra ba'i seṅge chen por dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje las mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dur gdangs dang / khams gsum kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med/ /'byung gnas kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dren pas bshad du gsol/ /zhes so/ /de nas slob dpon langs te/ khri'u chung dang mchod pa sogs bsdus nas/ badz+ra kī la ya sogs brjod cing byang shar du phyin/ dbus su kha bltas la mig sogs byin rlabs dang / bka' bsgo ba'i tshe/ rol mo drag rdung dgu rdeg stod smad du 'theng rdung gsum gsum dang bstun 'cham zhing / dam tshig chen po'i 'gros bzhin byas la gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ḥs phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /'byung po sha za srin po'i tshogs/ /gang dag gnas pa myur du song / /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' byung nas/ /gang dag mi 'gro de rnams la/ /ye shes rdo rje rtse dgu yis/ /mgo nas brgyabs nas rting par 'gems/ /zhes dang / rol mo gong bzhin gyi mjug tu chem rdung dang / kī la ya dang hūm̐ drag tu bzlas/ yungs dkar gyis brabs shing bskor ba byas/ byang shar du slebs pa dang gong bzhin dgu rdung sogs bya/ mchod g.yog pas slob dpon gyi sngun la gu gul gyis bdug go

/de 'dra ba lan gsum dmigs pa dang bcas pa bya/ stangs stabs dngos la skabs 'dir kho bos byas pa'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub bzhin rtsa 'cham rdzogs par mdzad rjes khro bcu'i stangs stabs dbyangs dang bcas ban phur thogs nas bya'o/ /bsdu ba dang spros bcas mi gshom na khro bcu'i stangs stabs rkyang pas chog 'cham tshul 'cham dper gsal lo/ /sa srung ba'i tshe slob dpon dbus dang / slob ma rnams ban+dha lag g.yas dang phur pa g.yon du bzung nas dbyangs dang bcas pas/ dzaḥnas/ las mdzod cig ces pa'i bar tshar ba dang / kī la ya gsum gyis bar du 'gros bya/ de nas rol mo chems rdung dang / hūm̐ ka ra sogs dang / oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā'i sngags brjod cing slob dpon gyis phur bu btab tshar ba dang / rol mo dgu rdung 'theng rkang sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin rnam rgyal man la 'dur gdangs dang bcas pas phur bu rnams rim bzhin btab tshar ba dang / rol mo rnams bzhag phyag rgya bcas shing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /sogs nas me ri'i sngags bcas bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin brjod cing / de nas 'cham chas rnams bzhag la srung ma rnams kyi bskang ba dang bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar grub nas tshogs dang rjes chog zur 'debs bzhin te sa chog go /bzhi pa sta gon la bzhi/ dkyil chog las/ sta gon la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /thig gdab lha dang bum pa dang / /slob ma sta gon gnas pa'o/ /thig la'ang ye shes las thig go /lha rnams sta gon gnas pa la/ /lha bskyed mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab/ /slob ma sta gon gnas pa la/ /spro bskyed sdom bzung byin gyis brlab/ /so shing dri chu chos bshad pa/ /ku sha srung skud gtor ma gtang / /mchod sogs rmi brtag cho ga'o/ /zhes pa las/

dang po thig gdab pa la gnyis kyi las thig ni/ dkyil chog bzhin no/ /ye shes kyi thig ni cho ga'i go rim bzhin rjes su 'chad/ gnyis pa lha sta gon la gshom gyi skabs su rdo rje phur pa'i zhing khams ma la sogs pa yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dpal chen po 'di nyid kyi gtor ma lnga stod zur gsum la smad zlum po mtheb kyus brgyan pa la mar gyis nor bu sogs ci mdzes byas pa'i g.yas su sman phud chang gtsang ma la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ g.yon du rak+ta khrag gtsang ma'am/ sha dmar chang la btab pa ste gnyis ka'i snod thod pa'am/ thod pa'i gzugs bzos pa rdo sogs gang rnyed du bya/ gzhan yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi dam rdzas dang / bskang ba bya na bskang gtor sogs rang gi phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga bsham/ tshom bu yum rnams la mi dgod/ sgos mchod la 'khor lo rgyas 'debs te bcu drug mdzad/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyi gong du mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin rlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs/ de nas sgrub thabs 'bring po kho bos bris pa bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa'i bar mdzad/ sta gon gyi tshom bu a mṛ tas bsangs pa nas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi bar zur 'debs bzhin la/ khro bo bcu'i sngags rnams bskyed tshig re dang bstun nas brjod/ sgo ma bzhi la yak+ṣi ṇi sogs sngags bzhi ka dus gcig brjod/ bskyed tshig rnams sbrel nas/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs kyi bar dang / de nas oṃ yo gi shwa ri sogs phur 'god kyi dam can skabs bzhin brjod la/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim khor yug na/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / ye shes pa spyan 'dren ni/ 'khor ba phur bu sogs dang / oṃ e h+ya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri sha hoḥs ma ya hoḥ

sa ma ya satwaṃḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ a dhi pa hoḥ pra ti pa dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+dha naṃ ka ro mis dam tshig pas ye shes pa la phyag bya/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra hasta tsa pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra a sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pas zhabs bsil zhing gdan la bzhugs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī li ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥyis spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi sogs sgo ma bzhi'i sngags kyis dgug gzhug bcings mnyes byas par bsam/ sku gsung thugs byin brlabs/ dbang bskur/ gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar zur 'debs bzhin dang / mchod bstod ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka la thun mong du yin pas mchod pa byin brlab ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta pha la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa dgos pa rnams 'di bzhin no/ /sgeg phreng gi rjes la/ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ badz+ra gīrti hrī/ badz+ra nīrti āḥ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ badz+ra a lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe a hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis rol chen dang / gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs mdzad/ mchod pa bsdus pa rnams 'di bzhin no/ /de ltar phyi mchod song nas nang mchod ni/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /nas/ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ gi bar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin dang / gsang mchod 'khril ba'i mchod chen sngags bcas/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'am/ khams gsum yongs su bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ mnyam pa'i bsgrub rdzas chen po ste/ /sogs sngags bcas/ bsgral mchod/ gdab kha dang po sngags bcas kyi mthar kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi hā hāḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de nas he ru ka yi gnas bcu sogs nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar sngags bcas brjod cing / gtor ma'i steng du rak+ta sgreng / kha 'phangs 'di rnams sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /de nas bstod pa nas bzlas pa'i bar zur 'debs bzhin la/ bzlas pa bsdu ba na ma rak+mo sogs gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs nas nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bsnyen sgrub gsal byed bzhin brjod/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun sogs sh+lau ka gcig byas nas/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /'od zer 'phro 'du'i klong dkyil na/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /khro bo khro mo rnam bzhugs pa/ /bran dang bka' mnyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag bdag gis ni/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bas 'dir bzhugs nas/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/

gsum pa bum pa sta gon la/ 'khyil bas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba sogs dang / gtso 'khor thams cad la khro bo rigs lngas dbur rgyan sogs te gzhan thams cad zur 'debs bzhin no/ /de nas yi dam chos srung rnams la gtor bsngo/ bshags pa/ bskang ba/ bstod pa rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la byas te tshogs byin rlabs sogs sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin dang / thun gtor 'bul ba sogs bya/ de nas mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs bsdus pa byas nas/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri chab nyer mchod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yis mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐ sogs rol chen/ gaṇ+ṭe ra ṇi rnams kyis phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas sh+lau ka gcig gis nang mchod/ sgeg cing dpa' sogs kyis bstod pa nas bkra shis kyi bar du zur 'debs bzhin grub nas/ tshogs pa rnams so sor gyes la/ slob dpon gyi mdun du sngar bshams pa'i tshon sna lnga dang / thig skud sogs dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga bsham/ gong du tshon gyi yi ge rnams slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses sngon po la hūm̐/ dkar po la oṃ/ ser po la swā/ dmar po la āḥ ljang gu la ha rnams bri'o/ /thig tshon bsangs sbyangs nas thig byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags bzla ba'i bar zur 'debs bzhin no/ /de nas srad bu rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam la/ de'i 'od kyis sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ yig 'bru gsum la thim ste/ 'od du zhu ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ slob dpon gyis thig skud rnams bsdus/ tshon gyi yi ge rnams mtheb srin g.yon gyis bsubs la/ sngon po'i rigs rnams la sngon po nas cung zad re bsre/ de bzhin dkar po sogs gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi rdo rje slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa la thig skud sngon po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu rnams rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyi don bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu gyur/ /oṃ ā n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmaḥs+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra añja li/ a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra ban+dha zhes brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig bsgril bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par bsam la/ rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la bzhag go /de nas slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas langs la thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung / dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar la kha blta/ slob ma rdo dril 'dzin pa shar nas nub tu kha phyogs pa la karmā badz+ra ha dz+dza gnyis brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dz+dzaḥganyis brjod cing thig sna blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung / slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya su tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod cing dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad logs thig rnams btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/

de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la tshangs thig dang po gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni gong du bshad pa ltar slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas nam mkha' dang sa la 'debs tshul tshig brjod pa rnams gong bzhin thams cad la shes par byas la/ slob dpon gyis rgyab sprod tshul du slob ma'i rgyab nas bskor te lho dang / slob mas rgyab sprod tshul du slob dpon gyi rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas shar lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas nub byang dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho nub tu gnas pas nub kyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas byang gi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho nub tu gnas pas lho'i logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma nub byang du phyin la zur thig dang po gdab/ slob dpon lho nub tu phyin/ slob ma byang shar du phyin te zur thig gnyis pa gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud slob dpon gyis rdo rje la dkri zhing bsdus la/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥzhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar btegs nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin te kha shar la bltas nas gzhi bca'/

pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying ga dang dril bu dkur bsten te hīḥhīḥzhes brjod cing khro bo'i blta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas pas sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chu slob dpon gyis rdo dril dang bcas bzhin pas srin lag gnyis kyis dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbyi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing thig phyi'o/ /ye thig bskor ba bya lugs 'di dkyil 'khor zhal shar bstan/ gnas khang sogs dgos byed stabs nas dkyil 'khor gyi zhal lho dang / nub dang / byang rnams la blta dgos byung tshe/ phyogs dkyil 'khor dang bstun/ mtshams 'jig rten pa dang bstun dgos te/ nag po dkyil chog las/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang ldan du bla ma mi 'gro ba dang / rnal 'byor pa'i phyogs dang 'jig rten pa'i phyogs so sor shes par bya ba gal che'o zhes gsungs pas slob ma mer 'gro mi nyan pa'ang shugs bstan gyis shes so/ /des na dkyil 'khor zhal lho dang nub dang byang du bstan na rnal 'byor pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi shar ni dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan pa de yin no/ /de bzhin du lho dang byang yang shes so/ /mtshams ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa kho na dgos pa'i phyir ma 'khrul ba gal gnad che bas slob dpon du gyur pa rnams kyis rtog pa zhib la blang / tshangs thig gnyis g.yas bskor du dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs dang bstun/ logs thig zur thig gdab lugs dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan rung / zhal shar bstan bzhin 'jig rten pa'i shar lho sogs nges pa can no/ /bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ kho bos byas pa'i mtshams sbyor blo gsal dga' ba skyed byed du blta'o// //spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/

dkyil chog las/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la yang gsum/ /dkyil 'khor bri dang byin gyis brlab/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes pa la/ dang po bri ba la gsum ste/ de nyid las/ bri la tshon gyis rim pa dang / /mtshan ma 'god rgyan dgram pa'o/ /zhes pa las/ dang po tshon dgye ba ni/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du phyogs pas 'dug la/ byang shar nas rtsig pa sgo tshad gcig tsam slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bri zhing / hūm̐ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /de byung rigs lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems can ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /tshon gyi las 'di bdag gis brtsam/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma badz+ra sa mā ya yaṃ a/ zhes brjod cing nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams cung zad bri/ de nas lag pa g.yas sam/ slob ma gzhan gyis rtsig pa byings dang sbom phra mthun par bris tshar ba dang / ting zhabs ra can gyis kha bcad nas zan sogs kyis mi 'chug par byas la zhabs ra'i steng du ye thig gi rdo rje tshon skud dkris pa de bzhag yid kyis me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga phul/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ sngon po rnams kyis bkang la/ slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pas bri/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na ting bsal te sbrel nas/ mtshan ma'i tshon bkra brtag pa ste rtsig pa gzhan las dma' ba byung na dngos grub mi thob pas ngan/ mtho na dngos grub 'byung bas bzang / yon po dang skyog po byung na bgegs zhugs pas bar chad kyi rtags yin te ngan/ shin tu 'drong na bar chad med pas bzang / rtsig pa chad na dpon slob gnyis ka 'chi bas shin tu ngan/ ma chad na bzang ngo / /ngan pa rnams byung na bsnyen phur lag tu bzung / kī la ya brgya rtsa la sogs gang mang bzlas rjes phur bus btab cing /

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba sha trun hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing dbang ldan rtsig pa'i ri mo bsubs te slar bri'o/ /bzang na yid kyis mchod pa lngas mchod/ tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi chos 'byung mthing nag mu khyud ljang / /mu khyud steng du rdo rje nag pos bri/ /zla gam gsum dmar mtha' skor mu khyud ljang / /'khor lo'i kha dog ser pos rab tu mdzes/ /mu khyud phyi ma rdo rje'i gdung yin pas/ /sngon 'gro'i steng du rdo rje ser pos bri/ /rtsibs chen phyogs mdog 'dod yon dmar po la/ /lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog bcu drug bri/ /sgo 'gram zur rnams zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan/ /pha gu ser po shing ris nag pos bya/ /de steng mtshams sogs rin chen phra tshom bri/ /drwa ba'i gzhi nag drwa ba dkar po dang / /shar bu'i gzhi ni rtsa ba lcags nag la/ /kha ni sngo skya de steng dkar po yis/ /spyi blugs mgo ni thur bstan 'dra ba bris/ /mda' yab gzhi dkar pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /nag pos bri zhing dmar sngo ljang sogs kyi/ /sna tshogs tshon gyis ci mdzes bri bar bya/ /mun pa glang rgyab gnyis ka nag pos 'gengs/ /glang rgyab steng du me tog dar dpyangs bri/ /ka ba rwa rnams phyogs mdog ka rgyan dang / /chu srin ci mdzes rta babs dang po dmar/ /gnyis pa sngo la gsum pa ljang gu dang / bzhi pa ser po de steng g.yas g.yon du/ /ri dwags gser mdog pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs/ /ci mdzes nyi dkyil ljang gu pad rwa ni/ /dkyil sngo mtha' rnams dmar ljang spel ba dang / /ze'u 'bru mtshon byed srubs rnams ser pos 'gengs/ /dam can snam bu'i gzhi ni dmar skya la/ /ser pos za 'og ri mo gang mdzes bri/ /de steng me tog sngo ljang gang legs 'god/ /dur khrod gzhi gnag phyogs mtshams chu yis bcad/ /chu ni sngo skya chu ris ci mdzes bya/ /dur khrod brgyad du phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/

/so so'i kha dog mthun pa'i tshon spung bya/ /grub thob brgyad la tshon mdog gang byung gi/ /tshon spung bkod na shin tu legs par mngon/ /shing me mchod rten ro dang keng rus dang / /shar du sprin ser lho sngo nub dkar po/ /byang ser byang shar dkar la shar lho dmar/ /lho nub nub byang sngon po'i sprin bri'o/ /chos 'byung mtshon byed mtha' la dmar skyas bcad/ /rdo rwa lcags nag rdo rje dkar pos bri/ /me ri sna tshogs phyag len ltar bris la/ /bcad rnams ci mdzes yid 'ong ldan par mdzod/ /bri ba rdzogs nas tshon gyi lhag ma dang / /ye thig srad bur bcas pa legs bsdus te/ /bla mas puṣ+pe la sogs mchod pa lnga/ /phul nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa/ rang la thim zhes ci bder gnas pas so/ /de nas nam mkhar btegs pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim zhes brjod cing bsam/ gnyis pa mtshan ma 'god pa ni/ ka to ra sogs phur bu rnams shong tsam gyi snod nas kyis bkang ba la/ gtso phur dang khro bo bcu phra thabs sgo ma bzhi ste bco lnga go rim bzhin dbus su dam can bcu gnyis dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad te phur pa bzhi bcu po mtha' la bkod nas gu gul gyis bdugs la/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang 'bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/

yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ eḥ yaṃ/ baṃ/ raṃ/ laṃ/ raṃ/ keṃ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ dzaḥpaṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ mā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus 'od du zhu nas gtso bor gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ḥgadan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /nas/ ye shes me phung dbus na bzhugs/ /kyi bar dang / rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med pas gtams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /bh+rūṃ bi mā na/ mā sūr+ya hūm̐/ dz+nyā na satwa kṛṣ+ṇa shu ka pañca badz+ra hūm̐/ kī la ya brjod/ om̐ dip+ta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bh+yoḥyum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur par bsam la/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/

/'khor ba rdo rjer bsgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing / 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rang la bstim/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo/ /yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang lha khro bo rigs lnga mdun du spyan drangs nas dbang bskur gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas sogs brjod pas/ ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud de khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri a zhes pa'i bar brjod/ kha 'phangs 'di rnams sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gang rung du blta'o/ /de nas phur pa rnams yungs dkar gyis brabs nas/ 'khyil bas bsangs ba nas gdan bskyed pa'i bar zur 'debs bzhin bya/ de nas phur gdan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang / 'khor lo'i rtsibs sgo bzhi dam can gyi snam bu'i steng rnams su bzhag slob dpon gyis gtso phur lag tu thogs nas gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ḥdabus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yang / /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dip+ta tsakra badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ rigs 'gre sbyar la/ steng nas rang byung༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ hūm̐ mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/

/sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /dbang dang༞ tshangs pa༞ dges shing༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ shar nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ rnam rgyal rdo rje sgeg mor bcas/ /sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbang dang༞ dri za༞ dges shing༞ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs rang rang gi sngags kyi mjug tu badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes pa thams cad la sbyar ro/ /me nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mor bcas/ /sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo /dbang dang༞ me lha༞ dges shing༞ oṃ badz+ra sogs so/ /lho nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ gshin rje'i rdo rje dur khrod bcas/ /sprul pa shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo /dbang dang༞ gshin rje༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ lho nub༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ mi g.yo rdo rje gtun khung bcas/ /sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /dbang dang༞ srin po༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ nub nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mor bcas/ /sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo /dbang dang༞ chu lha༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ rlung nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems bcas/ /sprul pa ce spyang khra yi mgo /dbang dang༞ rlung lha༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ byang nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ 'khyil ba rdo rje sgra mdzad bcas/ /sprul pa seṅge pha wang mgo /dbang dang༞ gnod sbyin༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ byang shar༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ khams gsum rdo rje gsod mar bcas/ /sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo /dbang dang༞ bgegs bdag༞ dges shing༞ sngags brjod/ 'og nas༞ sangs rgyas༞ chos dbyings༞ stobs chen rdo rje rig byed bcas/ /sprul pa dom dang byi ba'i mgo /dbang dang༞ sa bdag༞ dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ shar nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /'gugs byed chen mo pu shud mgo

/shar sgor nyi steng mi ro'i steng / /dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥbadz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ de bzhin du rigs 'gres te/ lho nas༞ 'ching byed chen mo bya rog mgo /lho sgor༞ dges shing༞ bhai ra be sogs brjod/ nub nas༞ sdom byed chen mo srin bya'i mgo /nub sgor༞ dges shing༞ a mṛ ta sogs brjod/ byang nas༞ mnyes byed chen po khra yi mgo /byang sgor༞ dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥbadz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ khor yug gi dam can dbang phyug ma'i phur bu rnams la zur 'debs bzhin brjod/ tshigs bcad rjes kyi sngags brjod pa dang bstun slob dpon gyis phur bu rnams rim pas las kyi rdo rje slob ma la gtad nas/ des phur gdan steng du legs par btsugs te bzhag gsum pa rgyan dgram pa ni/ phal cher zur 'debs bzhin la/ mda' drwa ni/ mda' ring thung med pa bcu rdza la sogs pa'i gdan la btsugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la 'khor lo'i rtse nas skya thig 'then pa'i rtags byas sar snyoms par bzhag tshon skud sna lngas mda' gcig gi ltong nas dkris/ mar phab 'phrin las kyi mda'i rtsa ba nas bskor la/ de'i 'phrin las kyi mda'i gyen la 'then/ ltong la dkris/ de bzhin gnang dus kyi 'khor ba dang / thog mar dkris pa'i stong nas de'i 'phrin las kyi mda'i stong la dkris/ yang de'i 'phrin las kyi mda'i rtsa ba nas bskor la de'i 'phrin las kyi stong la bskor te gong gi lan gnang dus byas nas 'khor ba dang mda' gnyis dbar du chos 'byung mgo sprad dang / mda' re re'i thad du nam mkha' 'dra ba yong / de nas steng du drag po rgya mdud e khraṃ nyer gcig bri ste/ de yang mda' gcig gi stong nas mda' gsum dbar du bzhag la bzhi pa'i stong la dkri/ de bzhin gsum gsum bzhag nas skud pa 'then te dkri/ thengs lnga pa la thog ma'i stong la bsleb yong /

de nas 'phrin las kyi mda' la 'phar te de'i stong la dkri/ yang gong bzhin mda' gsum gsum bzhag la skud pa 'then te dkri thengs lnga la 'khor yong / drag po rgya mdud ni 'dzom rnams yin la/ e khraṃ nyer gcig ni chos 'byung rtse nang bstan bcu dang phyir bstan bcu ste nyi shu/ dbus su chos 'byung bri cha la yong bas nyer gcig tshon skud la nyi shu yong ngo / /de nas ltong bcu po thams cad la bskor zhing dkris tshar ba dang / mda' gang rung gcig gi sdong nas mar phyed tsam dkris nas logs kyi chos 'byung mgo sprod mtshams kyi thad nas mda' re la dkri zhing bskor te 'khor ba dang / gong du dkris pa'i phyed man la dkris/ rtsa bar slebs pa dang / mda' thams cad kyi rtsa ba bskor/ de nas mda' rnams la 'byor na khro bo bcu'i zhal mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gdags/ ma 'byor na dar kha re gdags pas kyang chog gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa la bzhi ste/ dkyil chog las/ byin gyis brlab la tho 'jugs dang / /bum pa 'god dang lhag chad bskang / /gsol ba gdab pa'i bya ba'o/ /zhes pa las/ dang po tho 'jugs pa ni/ phyag len la dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhi'i shar du yul 'khor srung / lhor 'phags skyes po/ nub tu mig mi bzang / byang du rnam thos sras rnams kyi tsaka li'am bris sku dgram/ stegs ji ltar rigs par gtor ma zlum gtor gcig gi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga bshams pa shar gyi sku'i drung du khyer la/ dpon slob ji ltar rigs pa langs nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sku la kha phyogs te/ mchod pa byin rlabs zur 'debs bzhin dang / a ha ra'i dus rol mo bya/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum/ sku la dmigs nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du dhṛṃ las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung ljang gu/

phyag gnyis kyis pi wang sgrengs zhing / dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas grong khyer yul 'khor srung nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de nas rnga gsil dang bcas pas 'dur gdangs bya zhing / dri za dag gi bdag po'i rgyal/ /shar gyi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung / /yul 'khor srung nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā rā dza dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye yi sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim par bsam mo/ /sngags kyi bar la rol mo chem rdung dang gong 'og gnyis su gsum brdung lan bcas bya/ de bzhin kha gsal med pa'i tshigs bcad rnams la gdangs dang bstun gsum brdung dang / sngags rnams la chem brdung shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod rdzas 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces dang / rol mo'i bar la/ oṃ ma hā rā dza dhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ d+dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta prā tits+tsha swa hā/ zhes mchod/ rol mo bzhag la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ ma hā rā dza dh+riṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha kaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ gaḥgaḥn khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+yā de swāhā/ zhes gsum gyis phul la rnga brdung zhing / shar phyogs na ni gnas srung po/ /'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan/ /shar phyogs dag ni skyong byed pa/ /rdzu 'phrul che la stobs kyang che/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol/

/de nas rol mo bzhag la/ na moḥmachod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ rgyal po chen po gnas srung po 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /bsngo'o/ /sngon gyi thugs dam la mnos te/ bdag cag gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas phyi'i dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / phyi mtshams srung zhing dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing brtan par bzhugs nas phrin las sgrub par bsam/ de nas gong bzhin gyi mchod gtor lhor khyer la/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra bar rigs 'gre sbyar te gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ bskyed chog ni/ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du baṃ las rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sngon po g.yas ral gri gdan la brten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ grul bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / grong khyer 'phags skyes po nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa sogs/ grul bum dag gi༞ lho yi༞ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /'phags pa skyes nas༞ spyan 'dren༞ mchod pa༞ gtor sngags rnams kyi gong 'og 'dra/ /bi ru dh+ra ka'o/ /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /'jig rten༞ lho phyogs༞ rdzu 'phrul༞ mchod sbyin༞ rnal 'byor bdag cag༞ bar chad༞ dngos grub༞ 'phrin bcol dus/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas sogs so/ /mchod gtor nub tu khyer la gzhan gong 'og thams cad 'dra la/ khyad par ni bskyed chog skabs paṃ las rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang dmar po g.yas sbrul zhags/ g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ klu'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs so/ /grong khyer sna tshogs gzugs nas rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa sogs/

klu rnams kyi ni༞ nub kyi phyogs༞ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang / /sna tshogs gzugs nas༞ sngags rnams gong 'og 'dra/ /bi rū pak+ṣa pa zhes so/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /'jig rten༞ nub kyi༞ rdzu 'phrul༞ mchod sbyin༞ rnal 'byor bdag cag༞ bar chad༞ dngos grub༞ phrin bcol dus/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang sogs so/ /mchod gtor byang du khyer la gzhan thams cad 'dra/ bskyed chog la/ bai3 las rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu ser po g.yas rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug to/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ gnod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ grong khyer lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu 'khor dang bcas pa sogs/ gnod sbyin dag gi༞ byang gi༞ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu/ /lcang lo can nas༞ sngags rnams gong 'og 'dra ba las/ bai3 shra ma ṇa zhes sogs so/ /byang phyogs nas ni lus ngan po/ 'jig rten༞ byang gi༞ rdzu 'phrul༞ mchod sbyin༞ rnal 'byor༞ bar chad༞ dngos grub༞ phrin las bcol tshe/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul lo la sogs pa'o/ /dam sri mnan pa mi dgos pa bzhin mi mdzad/ gnyis pa bum pa 'god pa ni/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa/ mchod g.yog pas las bum dang spos thogs nas sna drangs gzhan yang rol mo dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum gyi rjes ma la/ gtso bo dang khro bo bcu rnams la bum pa 'bul ba'i stangs ka byas la/ lha re la phul ba dang bstun/ rang gi spyi bor gtugs pa re bya/ skor ba'i ring la kī la ya bzla/ bum pa 'jog khar shar du gnas pas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar mda' drwa'i bar gang 'os su bum gdan steng du bzhag las bum slob dpon gyis bzung /

mchod g.yog pas spos sogs gong bzhin gyis skor ba gcig byas/ 'khyil sngags brjod pas lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas la shar du gnas pas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil bas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod la mda' drwa'i bar byang shar gyi gang bder bum gdan steng du bzhag dkyil chog las rang sngags kyi phyogs mtshams su dbul lo gsung ba bzhin/ kī la ya la/ oṃ ni dpal chen yab yin te/ /badz+ra shes rab yum du brjod/ /kī li dang po khro bo bcu/ /kī li gnyis pa khro bo bcu/ /zhes de la sogs pa'i sgo nas gtso 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags yin pas bum pa 'bul ba/ sbyin sreg gi grangs 'dzin pa/ bsnyen pa sogs kī la ya 'ba' zhig mdzad pa 'di ni gtso 'khor thams cad tshang ba la dgongs shing don la gnas pas so/ /ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa dang / khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor bri ba la skyon du gyur pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa gsol ba gdab pa'i bya ba ni/ dpon slob rnams kyis dril gsil dang bstun/ sh+lau ka dang po la bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs dang / gnyis pa nas 'dur gdangs bya zhing / hūm̐ḥchos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo las/ /sku gnyis rnam par byung nas ni/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/

/dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa rnams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis med kyang ni/ /bdag gi slob ma dbang bskur phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la lnga ste/ dkyil chog las/ ting 'dzin bsgom la lha bskyed dang / /mchod tshogs gtor ma lhag chad bskang / /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po lha bskyed pa'i thog mar mchod pa gshom pa sogs phal cher zur 'debs bzhin las/ phyag len mi gsal ba cung zad brjod na dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la snum byugs pa dang / rdul mtshon gyi skor gyi rtsa ba ras bal gyis bsdams pa ni se mo sogs sems can mi 'byung ba'i ched lags/ dri bzang gi chus mi byug spyi mchod rdul skor nang / dkyil 'khor gyi me ri'i phyi la sta gon bzhin la/ sgos mchod ni sta gon bzhin bcu drug sgor mor/ spyi mchod nang ngam bar mtshams su bsham/ ma 'byor na phyogs bzhir spos mar me zhal zas re mdzad/ sgrub mchod lta bu dpon slob mang po ma yin par/ slob dpon kho nas bsdus pa nyams su len na sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar nyams su blangs la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis pa'i skur gyur zhes brjod/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa mdzad na bzlas pa bsdus te/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma mdzad/ rjes rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba mdzad nas/ rig 'dzin bskul ba bzhengs nas dkyil 'khor mtha' bskor du gnang / sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring gang mdzad na'ang / 'khor ba phur bu'i dus sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs pa yang spyan drangs la dgug gzhug gi tshe dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la mi dgos so/ /rdo rje sgeg mo'i gong du mchod pa byin rlabs bsdus pa mdzad/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ sgrub thabs khongs su 'du/ gsum pa tshogs ni/ rjes su 'byung /

bzhi pa phyi rol gtor ma ni/ rig 'dzin bskul nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi rol du stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du zlum gtor gcig dang / de'i g.yas su chu gnyis me tog dang gsum/ g.yon phyogs spos mar me dri dang gsum/ rgyab tu zhal zas/ mdun du nang mchod cung zad gcig rnams bsham/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas 'khyil bas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / dril bu gsil zhing / phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs su 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pa ri bā ra e h+ye hi pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ in+t+ra ye/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ta ye/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wa ya be/ ku be rā ya/ i shwa ra ya/ ur+dhaṃ brah+ma/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra/ a dhi pa ta ye/ a to pṛ thi wi bh+yaḥ.a su ra bh+yaḥs pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam la bzhag yang sngar gyi sngags kyi sa pa ri bā ra'i rjes la gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhupaṃ/ dīpaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ swāhās mchod/ de nas tshigs bcad re la dril gsil bya zhing / dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi sogs 'gre/ mchod cing sogs 'gre/ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po༞ lho phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i༞ lho nub༞ mchod cing༞ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po༞ nub phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po༞ nub byang༞ mchod cing༞ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po༞ byang phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po༞ byang shar༞ mchod cing༞ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ gong gi sngags kyi sa pa ri bā ra'i mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swāhā/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma phul te dril bu dang bcas pas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /swa swa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dges pas yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/

/bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsung / /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /de nas ji ltar rigs par rnga brdung shing dpon slob byings kyis dril gsil 'dur gdangs dang bcas pas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun spyod cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang rol mo gsum rdeg lan bcas grub mtshams/ dril bu bsil rdo rje thugs kar bzung la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang /

nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / 'jug cing dbang blang ba la sogs pa bgyid na/ slob ma yod na 'di dang sngon 'gro gtor ma sa lha sogs kyi gang dgos su slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba sogs skabs dang sbyar nas brjod rjes/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad zhi ba dang / dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod/ ces brjod pa'i bar la mchod g.yog pas zhal zas nas puṣ+pe'i bar rim pas bcug nas bsdus te gtor ma'i nang du blugs/ chu gnyis gcig tu bsgril/ me tog sogs kyi snod kha phub bo/ /dpon slob rnams kyis yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig brjod/ mchod g.yog pas gong du bsgril ba'i mchod yon gtor ma la cung zad blugs nas mtha' la bskor te gtor lam phyogs la gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis mtheb srin sbyar ba'i se gol gtogs la/ badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong rnams bsgrub khang gi phyogs bcur bzhugs nas bar chad thams cad srung ba'i las mdzod/ ces dang / nang mchod nas slob dpon gyis srin lag g.yon pas blangs nas slob dpon rang nyid dang / mchod g.yog pa'i gnas gsum du reg pa'i rnam pa tsam byas la bsrung ba'i mos pa bya/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal/ slob dpon sogs kyis rdo rje gsor dril bu bsil zhing kī la ya brjod/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ lnga pa lhag chad kha bskang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du sleb rim gyis zhwa phud/ rdo rje thugs ka dang / dril bu rgyun dkrol dang yig brgya brjod cing / dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor/ mi shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas bskor bar bsam/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'greng ste ma 'byor ba sogs gong gi lhag chad kha bskang ba bzhin la/

khyad par du yang ras bri ba la zhes pa'i dus dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la zhes pa brje ba tsam ma gtogs 'dra/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel na nub phyi ma rnams la/ chos dbyings dag pa'i ngo bo las/ /sogs gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bum bskyed byas la/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dkyil chog las/ dbang bskur la yang bdag 'jug dang / /slob ma dbang bskur rnam gnyis so/ /zhes te bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad 'dus byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi dbang thob pa'i slob dpon du slob dpon gyis gsung ba rnams gtso bos gsung bar bsam/ rjes zlos dgos pa rnams rang gi byed par bsam nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blang ste/ de'ang dkyil chog las sdom tshig gsung ba rnams rim pas sbyar zhing / kha skong cung zad dang bcas brjod na/ 'jug dang dngos gzhi dbang bskur gnyis/ /dang po 'jug la'ang phyi nang gnyis/ /phyi la spro dri bden pa brjod/ /chas gzhug la yang gdong bcing dang / /me tog phreng gtad phyi nang gi/ /bar chad bsrung dang nang sems bskyed/ /maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab phyi 'jug go /zhes pa ste thog mar las bum mam rnam rgyal nas chu cung zad 'thungs te khrus byas par bsam la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes brjod/ spro ba dri ba ni/ bu khyod tshur shog ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ /zhes gsung bar bsam/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la/ /bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu dga' bas 'tshal lags so/ /zhes rang gis lan btab/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ dril bu gsil zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/

/rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum/ chas su gzhug pa la gdong bcing ba ni/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma na ya hūm̐ gis gdong bcings par bsam/ me tog phreng ba gtad pa ni/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba lag tu gnang bar bsam/ phyi'i bar chad bsrung ba ni/ ku shas las bum gyi chu rang la gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi sogs sgo ma bzhi'i sngags dang / a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil sngags brjod/ nang gi bar chad bsrung ba ni/ nang mchod nas lce thog bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ nang gi sems bskyed pa ni rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi zhes dang / rdo rje snying gar reg la/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ dang po 'di dang gtang rag gi tha ma gnyis la maṇ+ḍal bdun ma rgyas pa brjod/ ye shes dbab pa sogs gzhan rnams la maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyis 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /slob dpon gyis kyang bdag gzhug gsol/ /lan gsum brjod pa ste phyi 'jug go /gnyis pa nang 'jug gi sdom ni/ nang la gsol phyag dam bsgrag dang / /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /sdom pa legs par bzung byas nas/ /ye shes dbab la dam bzhag dang / /maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab dngos rnams so/ /snang ba dri dang me tog dor/ /mig dbye me tog phreng ba'i dbang /

/da lta blta bar rab bskul nas/ /bstan pa la yang mtshan nyid dang / /rten dang brten pa'i rnam dag go /zhes pa las gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /rdor dril 'dzin pas gdangs bcas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lan gsum phyag 'tshal ba ni/ /hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bla ma'i phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod la bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor byas nas shar sgor gnas pas lus ngag yid gsum gyis phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bsgrag pa bdag 'jug la mi mdzad/ sdom pa bzung ba la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu dkon mchog gsum sogs bsam la/ thun mong ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor sngags bdag he ru ka /'khor lor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de rnams la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa gang / /bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /dus gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams/ /khyed la ma lus so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/

/rang rgyal dgra bcom nyan thos sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /de la rjes su yi rang bgyi/ /sems can ma lus srid par ltung / /'gro rnams kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis dus 'di nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa 'dzin snyam pas/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin gyi dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog sdom par ni/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas kyang / /sems can 'khor bar bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ /lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngon 'gro dam bzhag bzhi'i dang por phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ rigs kyi bu mchog tshur nyon cig /deng khyod bde gshegs 'khor bcas kyi/ /nang du khyod nyid zhugs pa na/ /slob dpon lung bstan ngas kyang ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /ye shes khyod la bskyed par bya/ /rnal 'byor bu mchog khyod kyis kyang /

/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dngos grub dam pa thob par gyur/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras par gyur na ni/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar gtugs la/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /khyed kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /gsum pa gnyis ka'am mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum chu'am/ nang mchod nas lcer bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed/ /rdo rje bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta ha na ha na u ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la/ deng nas brtsams te thams cad du/ /rdo rje gzhon nu nga yin gyi/ /nga yis smras pa bu yis gyis/ /nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig /nga la brnyas pa byas na ni/ /khyod ni sdug bsngal ma bral bar/ /tshe yi 'du byed byas nas ni/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung / /zhes so/ /maṇ+ḍal ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs kyi mjug tu phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes so/ /gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas rnams/ /deng 'dir bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ ye shes dbab pa dngos ni/ rang skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar/

g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi g.yas dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ g.yon dang po gnyis kyis me phung 'bar ba dang rtse gsum bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis phur bu 'dril zhing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i pang na yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod khrag rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i zhabs bzhi bgrad pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu chang zung thur du bstan zhing mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba re re/ sum mdor raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying gar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang lte ba la laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su has mtshan pa/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung de g.yos rkang mthil gyi dzhai mer 'bar/ long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar 'khyug 'khyug song / sum mdor gzhir gnas kyi me dang phrug chil te 'dres pas drag tu 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsros/ des mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung g.yos/ thur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying ga'i sa la thim pas bde ba dang lte ba'i me 'bar bas drod skyes nas snying gar bde drod 'dzoms pa la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/

slar yang mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rdo rje gnod sbyin ma mdog dkar mo pu shud kyi mgo can lcags kyu dang phur pa thogs pa mang po spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab par spyan drangs/ rang gi rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar btegs/ spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan/ lus bar snang du 'dar yed yed gnas pa'i spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim par gyur/ hūm̐ a ha dzhai lan gsum brjod nas rol mo rnams drag tu byas te/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya a be sha ya/ stam+bha ya stam+bha ya/ ra ra/ ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs brjod/ rol mo bzhag tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bya/ snang ba dri ba ni/ gtso bo bla mas kha dog dri ba mdzad par bsam ste/ dkyil 'khor steng gi nam mkha'i kha dog brtags la/ dkar ser dmar nag ljang gu'am sna tshogs rnams mthong na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs rnams 'grub bo snyam du dran par bya'o/ /me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hos sngar gyi me tog gtso bo'i dbur phul bar bsam/ mig dbye ba ni/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /mig gi ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /khyod kyi mi shes dri ma bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra pra be shā ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la mig dar dbye bar bsam/ me tog phreng ba'i dbang ni/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /me tog phreng bas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes me tog phul ba de mgo bor bzhag cing dbang bskur bar bsam/ de ltar na khyod kyi mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib dag nas ye shes kyi mig thob ste/ thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong ba yin no/

/zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba ni/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /shes rab rnam gsum rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni thugs kyi rigs su skyes/ /bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du gyur/ /'gro ba rigs drug thams cad la/ /bu bzhin snying rje kun la bskyed/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/ /zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bstan pas ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos pa bya ba'o/ /rten dang brten pa'i rnam dag ni/ /gzhal yas gru bzhir gyur pa ni/ /tshad med bzhi rnams rnam par dag /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /rta babs yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /drwa ba drwa phyed kyis brgyan pa/ /nyon mongs che chung rnam dag rtags/ /ka ba brgyad kyis dbus brgyan pa/ /'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag rtags/ /rin chen pha gu la sogs rgyan/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags/ /'dod pa'i lha mos brgyan pa ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro rnam dag rtags/ /sgo bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi rnams ni/ /rnam rtog bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /zur bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi rnams ni/ /phyi yi bdud las rgyal ba'i rtags/ /zhing gi bla bre bres pa ni/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rtags/ /rdo rje rwa bas bskor ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags/ /me 'od 'bar bas bskor ba ni/ /bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs rtags/ /bum pa rnams kyis brgyan pa ni/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i rtags/ /dpag bsam shing gis brgyan pa ni/ /thugs rjes yongs la khyab pa'i rtags/ /zhes brjod pa rten gzhal yas khang gi rnam dag go /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'o/ /khro bo chen po rnam rgyal ni/

/ngag 'khyal rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /brdzun du smra ba rnam par dag /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /srog gcod rnam par dag las byung / /khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon/ /log par lta ba rnam dag rtags/ /khro bo chen po rta mgrin ni/ /phra ma rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro chen gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /ma byin len pa rnam par dag /khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /tshig rtsub rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro chen khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ /gnod sems rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro bo chen po stobs po che/ /brnab sems rnam par dag pa'o/ /khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ /'dod log rnam par dag pa'o/ /de rnams kun gyi yum rnams ni/ /rnam par dag pa'i yum rnams so/ /shar sgor pu shud mgo can ni/ /snying rje rnam par dag pa'o/ /lho sgor bya rog mgo can ni/ /byams pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /nub sgor srin bya'i mgo can ni/ /dga' ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /byang sgor khra yi mgo can ni/ /btang snyoms rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes pa brten pa lha'i rnam dag go /de ltar na 'jug pa rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pas lam lnga las tshogs lam gyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /zhes brjod pa ste 'jug pa'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang la'ang bum dbang gsang dbang dang / shes rab ye shes bzhi pa'o/ /dang po bum dbang la yang gnyis/ slob ma slob dpon rnam gnyis so/ /slob ma'i sngon 'gro maṇ+ḍal dang / /gsol gdab byur bsal dngos la yang / /rigs lnga bdag po'i dbang rnams so/ /zhes pa ltar sngon 'gro slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur rnams/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang stsol cig /ces lan gsum/ byur bsal ba'i don du/

rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du seṅge'i khri pad+ma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes pa'i bar ye shes dbab pa bzhin byas la/ de'i steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ kī la ya brjod cing rol mo drag tu brdung ngo / /dngos gzhi rig pa'i dbang lnga ni/ rang dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis la ku sha'i rtsa bas las bum gyi chu gtor zhing a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od ……thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa 'di rnams mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo kho na yin/ 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da pha la ya/ biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / dril bu gsil zhing / mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med/ /skye med blo gros ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mchod cing bstod de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma dang / dbang lha rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams par bsam la/ rang gis rnam rgyal bum pa btegs te/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen gyi gdangs dang bcas pas/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /byang chub sems rab chus gang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur rgyan/ oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ badz+ra a ha ra li hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ u da pha la biṣ+pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang rol mo bya/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/

/de bzhin du rig pa'i dbang gzhan rnams kyi ngag 'don phal cher mi bskyod pa dang 'dra zhing / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par brjod na/ rin 'byung la rang dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs dang / gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren la thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par sogs dril gsil gyi bar bya/ lta ba ngan pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rin chen rgyal po yon tan gtso/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin chen 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ dbu rgyan lag tu thogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngags pa yi/ /rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi ṣiñca swā/ badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥzhes brjod cing dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs spyi bor bcings la/ rnam rgyal bum chu ku shas mgo bor gtor zhing / oṃ badz+ra bhā wa sogs nas mi bskyod pa'i tshab tu rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ rat+na sam+bhā wa badz+ra a ha ra li sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /'od dpag med la rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā las pad+ma ās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / 'od dpag med kyi rnam par nas dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje'i gsung ni dpag med pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung mchog dpal/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni kun 'byung ba/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /don ni byang chub sems yin pas/ /gnyis med don gyi ngo bo nyid/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca ā/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje lag pa g.yas pas gsor zhing bzung / bum chu gtor zhing dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ a mṛ ta bhā wa hrī sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa la rang dang dbang rdzas dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las gdan bskyed/ hā las ral gri hās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / don yod grub pa'i rnam par nas dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje las rab kun gyi gtso/ /sems can kun gyi don grub pa/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /las kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la/ 'di ni shes rab kun gyi dngos/ /byang chub bsgom phyir rang bzhin te/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/

/khyod la de ring 'dis dbang bskur/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dril bu lag pa g.yon pas gsil/ bum chu gtor/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhi sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad la rang dang dbang rdzas rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las gdan bskyed/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa sogs dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par nas dril gsil gyi bar dang / rdo rje'i sku ni dga' chen po/ /thams cad zhi ba'i mchog nyid gsal/ /rang gi ngang gis 'od gsal mchog /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sogs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ gsol ba btab la rdor dril lag pa g.yas pas gnyis ka bzung la dkrol zhing / 'di ni sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu bsngags pa gsang ba'i ming / /rang gi gsang mtshan brjod de mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya bas/ zhes pa lta bu/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa satwaṃ badz+ra na maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bum chu gtor/ dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ bai ro tsa ni sogs rol chen dang / de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/

/bdag po'i dbang la rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la rang nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje gzhon nu nas mnyam par sbyor ba'i bar dang / de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ sogs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ rang la bstim pa rnams gong byur bsal ba bzhin brjod/ rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang / thod pa a las ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ shes rab pad+ma'i snod yin te/ thabs mchog rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan 'dis/ /de ring khyed la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradz+nyā u pa ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje lag pa g.yas dang / thod pa g.yon du gnang bar bsam la/ thugs kar bsnol lo/ /de ltar na dbang rnam pa drug gi sgo nas kun gzhi'i dri ma bsal zhing / ma rig pa nyon mongs pa drug dag nas rig pa rigs drug gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ slob dpon dbang la maṇ+ḍal dang / /gsol gdab dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ /brtan byed bum chus dbang bskur zhing / /rigs gdab rgyas gdab rab gnas bya/ /bzlas lung rigs lnga'i sprul bshad dang / /dung sbyin rtogs pa bskyed rnams so/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /de ring bdag la rjes gnang stsol/ /lan gsum/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ rang gi lag gi rdor dril swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dril bu a las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ rdor dril lag pa g.yas g.yon du gnang bar bsam zhing / rang rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang / /shes rab chos kyi dril bu bzung / /phyag rgya chen pos byin brlabs te/ /dam tshig gsum po rab tu brtan/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po ru/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kā la ya sarba bigh+nān ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes dang dril bu gsil la rdo rje gsor zhing thugs ka dang / dril bu dku g.yon du brten la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ṭe āḥ de nas rdor dril snying gar bsnol la/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /slob dpon gyis ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /de ltar rdo rje gtad pas ni sems thabs bde ba'i ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa ni rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig go /dril bu gtad pas ni ngag gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig
