rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum skur gsal ba phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum po stabs gcig tu thob ste/ yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes nyams su myong bas don gyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob par bsam/ dbang de brtan byed bum pas dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab la/ rab gnas te ku shas rnam rgyal bum chu spyi bor gtor zhing / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa he ru kas gtsor mdzad pa'i khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa la lha thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' gsol zhing rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa yin no/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+tha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing nas 'bras gang rung spyi bor gtor/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra a hā ra sogs rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ bzlas lung ni bdag 'jug la mi mdzad/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad la/ rigs lnga'i nga rgyal rim pa bzhin bya zhing tshig dang bstun phyag rgya bcas la/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de bzhin du tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshab tu/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo༞ rin chen 'khor lo༞ pad+ma'i 'khor lo༞ ral gri'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes dang / dung 'bud pa'i tshul bya zhing / tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/ khyod kyis chos kyi dung bus shig /de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/

pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs bshad pa gyis shig de ltar na khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bri bsgrub dbang bskur/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi bsgrub pa la sogs pa slob dpon gyi bya ba thams cad la dbang bas slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhes skabs thob dang sbyar la bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing / lam lnga las sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa skyed pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus kyi dri ma dag ste sprul sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang maṇ+ḍal dang / /gsol gdab rig ma slob dpon phul/ /gdong bcing 'bru gsum brjod byas la/ /bdud rtsi gtor zhing bsrung ba dang / /slob dpon mkha' gsang byin brlabs nas/ /dbab cing byang sems lce la bzhag /gsal stong bsgoms la nga rgyal bzung / /gdong phye rtogs bskyed lung bstan dang / /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod rim bzhin bya/ /zhes te/ gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum dag pa'i dbang mchog 'di/ /de ring bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /lan gsum/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa slob dpon gyi phyag rgyar phul bar bsam la/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms/ /de ring bdag la dbab par zhu/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing gdong bcings par bsam/ bdud rtsi rang la gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung ba bya/ slob dpon gyi mkha' gsang byin brlabs ni/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/

rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kun da ltar dkar ba bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'joms te/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni dam pa nas/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ /zhes gnang bar bsam la/ nang mchod nas lce thog tu bzhag ste/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod cing myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag cing nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal pa che/ /yon tan kun gyis bdag brgyan te/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i bdag nyid do/ /'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing / lam lnga las mthong lam sa dang po'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des ngag gi dri ma dag ste longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no/ /lung bstan ni lag g.yas rdor dril dang / lag g.yon chos gos kyi grwa gnyis seṅge'i rna ba ltar byas la/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ston/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur+bhu wa swa/

'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad pa 'di ni sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo nyid du khyed gyur to/ /khams gsum bdag por khyed gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpar khyed gyur to/ /bdud dang mu stegs thams cad las/ /grong khyer la yang grong khyer te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /rnal 'byor snod ldan khyed zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu 'di yin/ /'di la the tshom ma byed cig /gzengs bstod pa ni/ da khyed rnams srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing / myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas rang la dman pa'i blo yongs su spongs la dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig gsum pa shes rab ye shes la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab gdong bcing bsrung / /rig ma gtad cing dri ba dang / /dri lan pad+ma'i che ba brjod/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs dga' bzhi bskyed/ /gdong g.yogs phye zhing rtogs bskyed do/ /zhes te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ji ltar mkhyen cing thugs chud pa/ /de ltar rjes su bdag dad na/ /de ring bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcings par bsam/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung / rig ma gtad pa ni/ bla mas rang la phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnang bar bsam la/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab 'di la brten nas grub/ /rigs kyi bu mchog khyed kyis kyang / /shes rab spang du mi rung ste/ /ye shes skye ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /khyed kyi 'dod chags ma spongs shig /rig mas dri ba ni/ bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/

/dri chen dri chu bza' nus sam/ /rak+ta ga bur btung nus sam/ /bud med dwang bas bsten nus sam/ /pad+mor 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig snod ldan ngang tshul can/ /rang gis dri lan gdab pa ni/ /shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /dri chen la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtag tu dad pas bsten par bgyi/ /pad+mar bdag ni 'o bgyid do/ /rig mas bha ga bstan te pad+ma'i che ba brjod pa ni/ rmad byung nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'di las 'byung / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyang / /rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral lo/ /pad+ma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las 'byung / /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /pad+ma zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /pad+ma'i nang gi nam mkha' zhes/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze'u 'bru'i dbus nas 'byung ba yi/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'o/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ /rig ma'i phyag g.yon pa rang gi lag pa g.yas par gnang bar bsam la/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ /khyed kyi ye shes skyed byed pa/ /'di dang khyod nyid rtag tu yang / /dad pas rtag tu 'grogs par gyis/ /'di la rtag tu rol bar gyis/ /de ltar shes rab phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang ste sgom lam sa bcu'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /nyams myong dga' ba bzhi bskyed pa ni/ rang rdo rje gzhon nu dang / rig ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan pa/ rang gi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag rtse mor phaṭa yig ser po/ yab yum 'khyud pa dang tsum+pa dang /

/gsang gnas sbyar ba'i 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te/ thig le dwangs ma rnams zhu/ spyi bo nas 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar byon pas dga' ba/ dbus su byon pas mchog dga'/ rtsa gsum 'dom pa'i gnas su byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor mthar thug par byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phyir ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzags par byas te rlung 'pho ba med pa'i gdangs dang bcas pas hūm̐ zhes yar drangs lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' ba/ yar drangs snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gang bas mchog dga'/ yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsams la/ lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab ste bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye bar bsam/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang / lam lnga las rgyu'i theg pa mthar phyin pa bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas/ des yid kyi dri ma dag ste chos sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin no/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin chen la/ /maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab 'bru gsum gyis/ /gdong bcing bsrung la dngos gzhi bsgom/ /gdong phye rtogs bskyed dam tshig bsgrag /bsrung zhing gtang rag maṇ+ḍal dang / /longs spyod phul dang spro ba bskyed/ /ces te/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab ni/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/

/lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing / bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas bsrung / dngos gzhi ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pas/ ji ltar snang ba 'di dag kun/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs med pa/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes brjod do/ /rang byung gi ye shes gsal la mi rtog pa de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag 'bru gsum brjod la gdong g.yogs phye/ rtogs bskyed ni/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob/ lam rang byung gi ye shes phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / lam lnga las 'bras bu'i theg pa mthar phyin pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa skye ba'i mthu dang ldan par byas la/ des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no/ /dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsung / /de bas de la brnyas pa ni/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni/ /ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la dmod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ /de la brnyas byas brgyad pa yin/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la/ /som nyi za ba dgu pa yin/ /gdug la rtag tu byams ldan pa/ /byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod/ /ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la/ /der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa/ /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/

/sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed/ /mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /dmod pa byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /sngags pas de dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyis bzung bar 'gyur/ /de bas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te/ /thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod par bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ /sngags pas 'bad de gzung bar bya/ /yan lag dam tshig ces bya ba/ /dam tshig dang ni mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang / /gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang / /sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / /sbyor ba nges par ma byas par/ /skal min gsang ba ston pa dang / /gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang / /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa la/ /dgos pa med par 'da' ba rnams/ /kha na ma tho bcas gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dam tshig mdor bsdus te bsrung bar bsam la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /lan gsum/ gtang rag tu oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba/

hūm̐ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa bla ma la dbul zhing cha shas kyi longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ gser dngul byu ru rin po che/ /glang chen ma he nor bur bcas/ /yid la gces pa rnams kyang 'bul/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /bdag gi lus kyang bzhes su gsol/ /lan gsum/ spro ba bskyed pa ni/ slob ma dam pa dam tshig can/ /khyed kyi 'byor tshogs shin tu che/ /dad mos med pas mi 'grub ste/ /dad mos che bas dngos grub thob/ /ces brjod// //spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ /sdom ni/ rjes chog la'ang srung gtor dang / /tshogs dang bsgral mchod lhag ma gtang / /bstan skyong phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol/ /phyi nang mchod bstod dngos grub blang / /yon bsngo bzod gsol brten pa lha/ /gtor mgron la sogs rten yod rnams/ /brtan bzhugs rten med gshegs gsol bya/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus te tshon bskyal zhing / /sbyin sreg bya zhing bdag srung la/ /lta bas rgyas gdab smon lam dang / /shis pa brjod pa'i rim pa'o/ /zhes pa las/ srung gtor ni gtor bsngo/ bskang ba dang bstod pa/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis rnams so so'i phyag len bzhin brjod/ sgrub chog zhag sbrel mar bya na/ nub dang po rnams la tshogs bar pa yan grub nas/ spyi stabs kyi thun gtor dbul/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor sh+lau ka gsum gyis bkra shis rnams rnga brdung dang bcas pas mdzad/

de nas 'og tu 'chad pa bzhin gyis mchod bstod bsdus pa dang / dngos grub blang zhing bzod gsol rnams bya/ brtan bzhugs gzhan 'dra la/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam sogs nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes pa'i mthar/ khyad par du yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / bum nang du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas sogs brjod/ gtor mgron gyi rten la ma ltos pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs dang / badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ dam can gshegs pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba rnams bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po yin pas mi dgos/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra sogs nas bkra shis kyi bar bya'o/ /nub tha ma la dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham mdzad pas rig 'dzin bskul ba 'og tu mdzad/ srung gtor sogs gong bzhin/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis yan grub rjes/ tshogs ni byin rlabs nas bar pa bshags pa yan kho bos byas pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po ltar byas la/ bsgral mchod ni rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ 'dir bsdus pa sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin la phyi nang gsang ba ma gtogs/ baiḍūr sngon po mi mdzad/ de nas tshogs bar pa yan grub nas/ dpon slob rnams 'cham chas gyon/ ban phur tshab rnga khyer/ gzhan 'os bab ji ltar rigs pas sbug chal dang / gser skyems/ gdab phur gsum/ ral gri/ yungs dkar/ rdo rje tho ba/ ras la bris pa'i g.yang gzhi'i snying gar 'brub khung gru gsum nag po me ri dang bcas pa sogs dgos pa'i yo byad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin khyer la/ 'cham rwar slebs nas g.yang gzhi slob dpon gyi mdun tsam du bkram/ g.yas phyogs su gdab phur sogs ji ltar rigs par bsham/ spos phor gu gul dang bcas pa yang bzhag go /de nas dgra bgegs brub kyi sngon 'gro rnga 'cham kho bo'i 'cham dpe ltar byas tshar nas nang du log

dpon slob ji ltar rigs pas rnga sil dang bcas ling gdan g.yang gzhi gding sar/ gser skyems byin rlabs byas nas/ bla ma rig 'dzin sogs gser skyems bsdus pa/ rig 'dzin bskul ba sgrub thabs bzhin/ do nub kyi phur kha sogs phur kha bsgyur ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka sogs nas/ dzaḥdzaḥ'i bar gyis lha srung spyan drangs/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /nas/ ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /zhes dang / kī la ya brjod/ dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha nas/ gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / liṅga bsgral yul bzas pa po/ sh+lau ka gcig ste gsal ba gsum dang gdeng gsum gsal btab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/ rgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin dang nas/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i grogs mdzod cig gi bar gyis ma nyes pa'i dpang 'dzugs pa rnams 'dur gdangs dang bcas sngags rnams la rol mo chem brdung / tshigs bcad rnams kyi mtshams su rol mo bzlog pa bzhin drag brdung mdzad/ kha 'phangs 'di rnams sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs su blta'o/ /de nas bskul dang bcas te dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham nged rang gi 'cham dpe bzhin rdzogs par bya/ liṅga bsgral zhing ling ro dbul ba rnams grub nas nang du log ste thun gtor dbul ba sogs bkra shis kyi bar gong bzhin bya'o/ /nub tha ma zhes pa bsgral ba'i mchod pa'o/ /dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham mi byed par dbang tsam bskur ba dang / phyag len bsdus pa sgrub mchod rkyang pa byed na/ tshogs tha ma bsgral mchod sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin byas nas/ lhag ma dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya/ rgyas pa'i phyag len 'cham sogs mdzad na nang par tshogs bar pa yan song nas lhag ma gtang ba ni snod gang yang rung bar sgrub mchod ring gi tshogs lhag bsdus pa rnams blugs la mdun du stegs kyi steng du chang bran la bzhag

dpon slob rnams kyis rnga sil dang bcas pas/ phaṭa s+pha ra ṇa zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas phaṭa byung bar bsam la/ ngag tu/ mdun gyi ye shes pa'i thugs ka nas phaṭa nag po gcig 'phros te rang gi snying gar thim pas bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur/ kī la ya nas bh+yo'i bar gyi lha sngags thams cad brjod/ de'i rkyen gyis bdag dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gsal lam gyis byung bar bsam/ rol mo bdun rdeg gsum byas nas/ khro bas khro ba sogs nas sarba a na ya sogs kyi bar dbyangs dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don 'grub bzhin mdzad/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i ring la ji ltar rigs pas mda' dra/ rdul skor/ sgos mchod/ phur gdab kyi khro bo bcu'i phur bu rnams bsdus/ phur bu 'o mas bkru ba sogs mi gnang / dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i khyams kyi steng g.yas su rnam rgyal dang / g.yon du las bum bzhag go /bstan skyong ni thog mar dpon slob rnams bzhengs te rnga sil dang ldan pas/ dpal ldan phrin las kyis pu tra bskul zhing rim pas sgrub khang gi steng du phebs nas spyi stabs nam mkha' 'brug sgra dang bcas te srung gtor rnams phul/ de nas bya khyung gi phyag rgya zil gyis mnan la/ hoḥbod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs nas/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin gyis bstan ma'i gtor ma phul zhing rang gang 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol la/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor gyi bkra shis grub mtshams/ phyogs skyong gshegs su gsol ba ni/ gtang rag gi gtor ma gtong ba yin te/ steng gi shar lho'i mtshams su mchod gtor cho ga rnams phyi rol pa ji lta ba bzhin las/ badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes pa tsam ma gtogs 'dra/

de nas mchod g.yog pas spos sna dang / gzhan rnams kyis rol mo dang bcas pas nang du log rim pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum yig brgya 'don bzhin par byas te slob dpon shar dang / gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor la 'khod pa dang / rol mo rnams bzhag go /phyi nang mchod bstod ni spyi mchod rnams kha gsos la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa bya/ sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis nang mchod/ sgeg cing dpa' dang sogs kyis bstod pa rnams sta gon gyi rjes chog bzhin bsdus pa mdzad/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sogs lan gsum gdangs dang bcas pa brjod cing thal mo snying gar sbyar/ yon bsngo ba ni slob dpon gyi mchog bsngo dang / sbyin bdag gi don du dgos pa byung tshe/ gshin bsngo gson bsngo sogs skabs thob dang sbyar nas bya'o/ /bzod par gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs lhag chad kha bskang ba phyi rol pa'i rjes su bya ba bzhin bzod par gsol/ brten pa lha phur dang / gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i rten 'di rnams dang / brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med gshegs gsol bya ba ni/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ bum nang gi lha/ gtor mgron la byon pa'i rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs gdangs dang bcas pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing rol mo rnams dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dam can gyi phur bu nas gtso phur bar rim gyis bsdu zhing spyi bor reg gzhan las slob rnams kyis phur gdan dang / bum pa bzhi rnams bsdu/ rnam rgyal dang las bum yang bde sar bzhag oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twad/ zhes brjod cing chos thams cad skye ba med pa de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshegs/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi me ri nas lte ba'i bar rdo rje'i rtses ri mo 'then/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams gzhan rnams la'ang bya/ de nas bsgrub g.yog pa kha cig gis ku sha sogs kyis mtha' nas bsdus te rin po che la sogs pa'i snod gtsang mar blug slob dpon gyis las bum sogs kyi bum chus thig rjes rnams mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /tshon bskyal ba ni/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drang ba'i cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba'i rgyas pa'am/ bsdus pa dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin bya ste phyag len la mi mdzad/ sbyin sreg ni grub na skabs 'dir sa los mdzad pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od dang dkyil chog bzhin no/ /'on kyang deng sang mi mdzad/ bdag bsrung ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku ma ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭa kyis rdo rje'i go gyon par bsam pa'o/

/lta bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ rang bzhin sems kyi sogs sh+lau ka phyed dang gnyis dang a kā ro sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar brjod cing / chos thams cad gdod nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ sogs sh+lau ka gcig sgrub thabs bzhin dang / dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ sogs smon lam gang shes bya'o/ /shis pa brjod pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad la me tog nas bkye la dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ bla ma'i bkra shis gang shes dang / hūm̐ḥskye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi shul sogs la me tog gi char dbab cing bkra shis par bya ba ste rdul tshon gyi phyogs thams cad bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni kho bos byas pa'i mtshams sbyor du rtogs par bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la sa chog tho 'dzugs pa/ bum pa 'god pa sogs mi mdzad/ gzhan zur 'debs bzhin no/ /nub phyi ma la bsgral mchod sogs mdzad pa ste phyag len gyi rim pa'o// //bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i lam/ /dbang gi cho ga'i gsal byed mchog /sa lo'i phyag len ji bzhin bkod/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba des/ /bdag sogs mar gyur 'gro drug rnams/ /shes rgyud sgrib gnyis rab sbyangs te/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu thob par shog/ //rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi cho ga'i phyag len gyi gsal byed blo gros kha 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i zur 'debs gsal byed rin po che'i do shal gyi zhabs 'degs su/

'gro ba'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rtogs par sla ba la brten cing / cung mi gsal ba rnams sa lo chen po'i phyag len gsung sgros kyis brgyan te/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku'i dbon po bla ma rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dpal ldan pa dang / snar thang phur dpon shākya 'od/ mnga' ris pa bla ma 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ dngul chu'i bla ma nam mkha' dpal 'byor sogs chos tshul 'di la shin tu dad cing 'dun pa'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba dang / rigs kyi bu bsod nams dbang po/ grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan spun sogs la bsams nas/ rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can sku mched/ yongs 'dzin dam pa dkon mchog lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa snyoms las pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad pa dang / mos pa dang / chos tshul 'di nyid phyogs thams cad du dar ba'i rkyen du gyur na snyam zhing / bskul ba po sogs la phan pa'i bsam pas/ rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i gnas mchog lha khang chen mo'i yang steng po tā la smon gnas yid 'ong dga' tshal du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dpal 'byor gyis bgyis so/ /'dis rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// //shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 52 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 53
